title: Configure the WSUS client through the registry
description: Configure the WSUS client settings by changing the matching registry keys

windowsCommandTemplate.name: Set-ItemProperty
windowsCommandTemplate.commandPattern: $WSUSServer = '{wsusServer}'; $WSUSPort = {wsusPort}; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name 'WUServer' -Value "http://$WSUSServer`:$WSUSPort" -Type String -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name 'WUStatusServer' -Value "http://$WSUSServer`:$WSUSPort" -Type String -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU' -Name 'UseWUServer' -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force; Restart-Service wuauserv

parameters.name: wsusServer
parameters.label: WSUS server
parameters.description: Host name or IP of the WSUS server

parameters.name: wsusPort
parameters.label: WSUS port
parameters.description: WSUS server port (8530 HTTP or 8531 HTTPS)

examples.command: $WSUSServer = 'wsus.contoso.com'; $WSUSPort = 8530; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name 'WUServer' -Value "http://$WSUSServer`:$WSUSPort" -Type String -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name 'WUStatusServer' -Value "http://$WSUSServer`:$WSUSPort" -Type String -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU' -Name 'UseWUServer' -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force; Restart-Service wuauserv -Confirm:$false
examples.description: Run the action without an interactive confirmation. -Confirm:$false suppresses the prompts. Useful in automated scripts, but use it with care: there is no safety net.

examples.command: $WSUSServer = 'wsus.contoso.com'; $WSUSPort = 8530; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name 'WUServer' -Value "http://$WSUSServer`:$WSUSPort" -Type String -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name 'WUStatusServer' -Value "http://$WSUSServer`:$WSUSPort" -Type String -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU' -Name 'UseWUServer' -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force; Restart-Service wuauserv -PassThru
examples.description: Make the command return the modified or created object in the pipeline. By default the Set-/New- cmdlets return nothing. -PassThru enables the return for chained operations or immediate checks.

examples.command: $WSUSServer = 'wsus.contoso.com'; $WSUSPort = 8530; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name 'WUServer' -Value "http://$WSUSServer`:$WSUSPort" -Type String -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name 'WUStatusServer' -Value "http://$WSUSServer`:$WSUSPort" -Type String -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU' -Name 'UseWUServer' -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force; Restart-Service wuauserv -Verbose
examples.description: Show detailed information about the command's execution. -Verbose enables debug messages to understand exactly what happens. Essential for troubleshooting and for understanding the internal operations.

examples.command: $WSUSServer = 'wsus.contoso.com'; $WSUSPort = 8530; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name 'WUServer' -Value "http://$WSUSServer`:$WSUSPort" -Type String -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name 'WUStatusServer' -Value "http://$WSUSServer`:$WSUSPort" -Type String -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU' -Name 'UseWUServer' -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force; Restart-Service wuauserv
examples.description: Example using the 'wsusPort' parameter: WSUS server port (8530 HTTP or 8531 HTTPS). Replace 8530 with the value that fits your environment.

notes: WARNING: modifies the registry. Port 8530=HTTP, 8531=HTTPS. Requires a restart of the wuauserv service. Meant for machines outside a domain.
